integrity: Proof by finite-state spectral decomposition plus exact hinge monotonicity; rational checks confirm both explicit witnesses. Independently validated proof is not claimed.
scientific_limitations: Exact finite-state reversible gate, canonical preparations, strictly ordered couplings, and true distance metrics; neither noisy experiments nor arbitrary generators are covered. The literature review cannot certify global priority.
title: The order of two genuine Mpemba crossing metrics can reverse in a reversible three-level gate
